listed_quote.quote: to evaluate a potential exit event for OSI II stockholders, including (1) a listing of OSI II’s common stock on a national securities exchange

announcement.quote: Oaktree Specialty Lending Corporation (NASDAQ:OCSL) (“OCSL”) and Oaktree Strategic Income II, Inc. (“OSI II”) today announced that they have entered into an agreement to merge together with OCSL as the surviving company

outcome_evidence.quote: is pleased to announce the closing of the previously announced merger with Oaktree Strategic Income II, Inc. (“OSI II”), with OCSL as the surviving company.

deals.notes: The merger was completed on the text of the 2023-01-23 8-K (stockholder approvals announced 2023-01-20), but the target OSI II was an unlisted BDC (OSI II's cover shows no trading symbol or exchange, and its Q&A treats a listing as a possible future exit event), so only OCSL is shown as Nasdaq-listed. Not a failed deal.
